frozen_diagnosis: The spatial conditional mean is safe but oversmoothed. Full-strength flow learns non-memorized stochastic variation but replaces too much scaffold geometry: diversity passes while anatomy, morphology, volume, and shape gates fail. The next arm must make the learned residual subordinate to a target-free structural scaffold.
hypothesis: A source-balanced contextual KNN scaffold plus a bounded scaffold-conditioned rectified-flow residual can retain retrieval generalization and route safety while adding non-memorized local anatomical variety.

scaffold.outer_fold_policy: exclude the entire held-out cave and acquisition campaign
scaffold.training_crossfit_policy: for each training cave, exclude both the outer held-out cave and that training cave from its scaffold bank
scaffold.nested_offset_selection: maximize source-balanced cross-section sign IoU on cross-fitted training caves only; ties prefer smaller absolute offset then smaller signed offset

flow.conditioning: frozen spatial-transformer graph hidden state plus the downsampled KNN scaffold plane
flow.x0: seeded correlated Gaussian noise scaled to 0.25 RMS
flow.x1: target minus nested-calibrated KNN scaffold, clipped to [-0.5, 0.5]
flow.runtime_projection: clip generated residual to [-0.5, 0.5] before bilinear 33x33 upsampling and addition to scaffold

training.source_sampling: equal patch count per available training cave

development_sampling.selection_arm: quantized mean of three individually quantized bounded residual samples

claim_limit: development-only mechanism recovery after two frozen failures; no validation or sealed claims
